The parties hereto have been advised that on the date hereof Seller's Existing Building uses less than the maximum Floor Area Development Rights that are permitted for development on Seller's Land pursuant to the Zoning Resolution,and that,therefore,Seller has available the Excess Development Rights that, under procedures currently available under the Zoning Resolution, may be made available to permit the construction of Developer's Proposed Building with Floor Area greater than that which would be permitted if the Excess Development Rights were not so made available. Seller wishes to sell to Developer, and Developer wishes to purchase, the Excess Development Rights in order that Developer's Proposed Building be permitted to have Floor Area greater than that which would be permitted if the Excess Development Rights were not so made available and, in any event, that Developer shall be the owner of the Excess Development Rights. The parties hereto (among others) have executed and delivered a certain Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the “Declaration") dated the date hereof, which is intended to be submitted contemporaneously herewith for recording in the New York County Office of the Register of The City of NewYork with respect to the Combined Zoning Lot. Section 1.2  Seller hereby grants, transfers and conveys to Developer an exclusive perpetual easement for light and air over and above Seller's Existing Building (the "Easement").
